UK 10-Year Gilt Yield — Trading Economics (fetched ~07:57 GMT, 4 Nov 2026)
Latest value: 5.2688% | change +0.021
"The UK 10-year gilt yield climbed back above 5.2% on Tuesday, recovering from near two-month lows as investors awaited Thursday's Bank of England policy decision and the US midterm elections. UK borrowing costs eased in October after Chancellor John Healey's first budget reassured investors by adhering to the government's fiscal rules."
"The BoE is widely expected to deliver its first interest rate hike since 2023 on Thursday, amid inflationary pressures linked to the Iran war and signs of resilience in the UK economy. However, policymakers are expected to push back against market expectations of further rate increases next year."
"The yield on United Kingdom 10Y Bond Yield rose to 5.27% on November 3, 2026, marking a 0.02 percentage points increase from the previous session."
